$description: ReUI design tokens (W3C Design Tokens format). Source of truth for the island's look; compiled into the reui-design crate. Values are DIPs unless noted. Geometry starts from the Figma 'Dynamic Island - Live Activities' kit, adapted for a desktop without a camera cutout; colours follow Apple's dark system palette. See DESIGN.md.

display.$description: Large text (20+): hero values and numerals

mono.$description: Commands, paths, code; ships with Windows 11

on-accent.$description: Text on a solid white or accent fill

track.$description: Unfilled part of rings, bars and progress

default.$description: Used when an activity doesn't set its own accent

logo.$description: Share of its tile a brand logo fills

glow.$description: Halo under expanded rings; 0 turns it off. A wide translucent stroke reads as blur, not glow, at island sizes

tint-wash.$description: Accent at the top-left corner of a tinted card (music, from the artwork); it fades to nothing by island.expanded.tint-extent of the width

art-stroke.$description: White hairline (1 physical px) just inside image art, so a cover with a black background still shows its edge on the black island

typography.$description: Three levels in every expanded view: eyebrow (small, accent) > hero (large, primary) > detail (secondary).

eyebrow.$description: Source or category above the hero, in the accent colour

headline.$description: Hero text when it isn't a number

code.$description: Hero commands and paths, set in a chip

card-text.$description: Wrapped text inside a preview card

card-code.$description: Wrapped code inside a preview card

card-title.$description: Wrapped title inside a card (page titles, file names)

card-label.$description: One-line label inside a card (link host, file name, colour value)

tab.$description: Filter tab labels; their counts use the same style, tabular and quieter

search.$description: Text typed into a search field and its placeholder

note.$description: The one quiet line a panel shows when there is nothing else ("No matches")

lyric.$description: Synced lyrics: the current line in primary ink, the next one under it in secondary

pager.$description: "1/2" between the source switcher's chevrons (tabular, secondary)

tile.$description: Glyph inside an expanded art tile

search.$description: Magnifier at the start of a search field

star.$description: Pinned mark in a card footer

top.$description: Gap between the screen's top edge and the island

height.$description: Idle, compact and minimal height (Apple's island)

width.$description: Resting pill with nothing to show

center-gap.$description: Space between the leading and trailing sides. Apple reserves 126 for the camera; Windows has no cutout, so this only separates the two sides

side-margin.$description: Inset of round content (art, ring, tile) from the pill's ends: a 24 circle sits concentric in the 36.67 capsule

text-margin.$description: Inset of text and bare glyphs from the pill's ends, clear of the end curve

max-side.$description: Longer compact text is ellipsised at this width

peek-grow.$description: Extra width and height while hovered

wide-width.$description: For rich content that asks for it (clipboard cards)

max-height.$description: Apple caps third-party activities at 160 on a phone. A desktop has room for the full music card: inset 20 + header 64 (eyebrow, title, detail) + section gap 16 + timeline with its times 16 + row gap 12 + transport 40 + row gap 12 + volume 32 + row gap 12 + two lyric lines 40 + inset 20 = 284. The clipboard panel needs 244

inset.$description: Padding on every side; concentric inner radius = radius - inset = 24

section-gap.$description: Between the header and the first row

tint-extent.$description: Share of the card's width over which a tinted card's accent wash fades out, from the top-left corner

radius.$description: Corners are concentric: anything that sits one inset from the island's edge uses radius - inset, so curves stay parallel.

chip.$description: Code chips and small wells inside text

compact.$description: Circle: concentric with the compact capsule

trailing.$description: Circle: it sits against the island's rounded side

height.$description: Text capsules; radius is height/2, close to radius.concentric

inline.$description: Circular glyph buttons beside the hero

transport.$description: Circular glyph buttons in a full-width row (same as inline)

height.$description: Rich preview cards (clipboard history); four across the wide island

footer.$description: In-card strip: source app icon, age, one fact

media.$description: Share of a link card the page image takes

visible.$description: Cards across the row when they all fit

visible-more.$description: Cards across when there are more: the half card at the edge says the row scrolls

ring-width.$description: Accent ring around the selected card

ring-gap.$description: Clear space between a card and its ring; the ring's radius is the card's plus this, so they stay concentric

height.$description: Search field and its icon buttons (circles); the field is a capsule, the closest it gets to radius.concentric

padding.$description: From the field's ends to the magnifier and text; also a text button's side padding

caret.$description: Width of the steady (never blinking) caret while the field has the keyboard

padding.$description: From a tab's ends to its text

count-gap.$description: Between a tab's label and its count

hit-pad.$description: Extra clickable height above and below a seekable bar (timeline and slider)

size.$description: Circle at the end of a seekable bar's fill; shown only while it's hovered or dragged

height.$description: Volume row: glyph buttons at both ends (circles), the bar between

gap.$description: Between a slider's buttons and its bar

hit.$description: Width of each chevron's click target in the source switcher

lines.$description: Lines the lyrics row keeps (current, next), so the card doesn't change height as lines change

reduced.$description: Used for everything when Windows animations are off

damping-offset.$description: Height settles slightly calmer than width

collapse.$description: After the pointer leaves an expanded island

hover-intent.$description: Pointer must rest this long before the pill takes clicks; quicker moves and clicks reach what's underneath (browser tabs)

decision-hold.$description: A decision that opened itself folds back to compact (still pending) if not engaged

panel-idle.$description: A card opened with a hotkey (clipboard history) stays until dismissed, or this long untouched

reveal-hold.$description: In a hidden visibility mode, how long the island stays after the pointer leaves it once revealed from the top edge

fade.$description: Opacity part of showing and hiding (shorter than the motion so the shape leads)

logo.$description: Working animation of brand logos: a quick eased quarter turn every interval, still in between. Continuous spinning cost DWM ~21% of a core; ticks only make it work during the turn

show.$description: The island emerging from (and retracting into) the top edge when its visibility changes

rise.$description: How far above its resting place the island starts / ends

compact-out.$description: Compact content is gone after 1/4 of the expansion

expanded-in-start.$description: Expanded content starts fading in at this progress

scroll.$description: A scrolling card row eases to its target, driven by a short timer that stops once it settles (no idle cost)

time-constant.$description: Exponential approach: about 95% of the way after three of these

bars.$description: Level bars move while something plays. The island drives them itself at a fixed rate instead of a compositor animation: DWM then only redraws when they change (30 times a second) rather than every display frame

attack.$description: Real visualizer: how fast a bar rises to a louder band (time constant)

release.$description: Real visualizer: how slowly a bar falls back (time constant)
